sentences.en: The elevator shaft goes all the way to the basement.
From here, you can look down the elevator shaft.
sentences.zh: 从这里你可以往下看电梯井。

sentences.en: These crank shafts are precision balanced for smooth high revving engines.
sentences.zh: 这些曲轴经过精密平衡，适合高转速发动机使用。
